description: This is a Java interface defining a service for reading credit report data within the Fineract project. It declares a method for retrieving credit report details given a credit bureau ID.

classes.name: CreditReportReadPlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface for a service that provides functionality to retrieve credit report data within the credit bureau infrastructure.
